meta.name: synthetic_delhi_winter_2023_24
meta.description: Deterministic synthetic hourly fixture for offline episode evaluation. Not observational data.
meta.disclaimer: Synthetic construct for method development only; do not treat as CPCB/OpenAQ measurements or as attribution ground truth.

case_studies.label: Diwali festival combustion
case_studies.narrative: Short multi-day festival window with elevated local combustion signals and often weak nocturnal mixing. Evaluation checks temporal alignment and local-combustion evidence language—not a pollutant concentration truth set.
literature_hooks: Festival-period PM spikes in Delhi literature

case_studies.label: Post-monsoon stubble / regional transport
case_studies.narrative: Broader post-monsoon window associated with agricultural residue burning upwind of Delhi–NCR. Rubric scores fire/transport evidence consistency and uncertainty phrasing against published case timelines, not station-by-station labels.
literature_hooks: Transport + local mixture framing in winter episode studies

case_studies.label: Local winter stagnation
case_studies.narrative: Multi-day mid-winter stagnation with suppressed boundary-layer mixing and dominant local sources. Rubric emphasizes meteorology context and avoidance of over-attributing distant fires.
literature_hooks: Local combustion and industrial contributions under poor dispersion
